capabilities: Render a whole-year calendar from a year_glance code block
Define event categories with shared or custom colors
Mark single-day and multi-day date ranges as events
Choose compact or expanded display with palette presets
extras: The README notes the community-plugin listing was still under review and not yet available, so manual installation was the working option at the time of writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see a full year at once with events visually marked and color-coded on a calendar.
summary: Yearly calendar renderer that draws a whole-year view in a code block with events marked as colored category indicators.
